Inside was a folded note, its ink blurred but still legible: “If you see the beacon, tell my sister I made it home.” There was no name, only a date from forty years earlier. Elias searched the harbor records and asked the oldest fishermen. At last, a retired woman recognized the handwriting as her brother’s, a sailor lost at sea before she was born. For the first time, the lighthouse keeper watched a light go out—not the beacon, but a grief that had lasted decades.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有完全醒来。高楼沉在深蓝色的天幕下，窗户零星亮着，像远处尚未熄灭的星星。街道空荡，清洁车缓缓驶过，水珠映出路灯昏黄的光。早点铺升起薄薄的白雾，蒸笼里传来面香，店主揉着惺忪的眼睛开始忙碌。偶尔有出租车从路口掠过，轮胎声很快消失在寂静里。公园中，树叶挂着夜露，长椅静静等待第一位晨练的人。天边渐渐泛白，鸟鸣越过屋顶，城市在微凉的空气里伸了个懒腰，准备迎接新的一天。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by asking a smaller version of itself.\n- Imagine opening nested boxes: each box contains a smaller box, until you reach one with a toy instead of another box.\n- A recursive program needs a stopping point, so it knows when to stop opening boxes and return the answer."}
